description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the NationalityAPI REST API, testing CRUD operations and utilizing fixtures and mock services within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: NationalityAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the Nationality API endpoints including retrieval, creation, update, and deletion of nationality records.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case by truncating the nationality tables before each test.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of all nationality records via the API.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of a single nationality record by ID via the API.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests the creation of a new nationality record via the API.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an existing nationality record via the API.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deletion of a nationality record via the API.
